scenario_description:
Objective: Gain a no-cost macro-photo keepsake for a finished fantasy warband during an already planned store painting night.
Emerging Need: A possible photo add-on becomes useful only after staff confirms eligibility, tray limits, and a short signup window.
Decision Context: Theo’s project record is needed to identify a qualifying finished piece and provide its footprint without guessing from the notices alone.
Consequence: Timely coordination could add a small showcase benefit; ignoring it simply leaves the painting night unchanged after the slots close.

parameter.title: Isthmus winter paint-and-play night
parameter.description: Open hobby tables, casual skirmish demos, and bring-your-own project painting.

parameter.subject: Possible photo backdrop add-on for Saturday paint night
parameter.body: We may have a volunteer photographer set up a small winter-ruins macro backdrop during Saturday's paint-and-play night. Staff still needs to confirm table space and riser dimensions, so there is no signup or hold list yet. If it happens, it will be a free extra alongside the regular hobby tables.

parameter.content: I asked at Isthmus this morning: the photo station is likely, but staff said not to claim anything until they post the final tray footprint and eligibility. The backdrop is tiny, so they may limit it to one skirmish-sized fantasy display per person.

parameter.subject: Saturday macro-photo slots open until 7:30 PM tonight
parameter.body: The winter-ruins macro backdrop is confirmed for Saturday. Six free slots are available for finished fantasy skirmish pieces on scenic bases; the display tray must be no larger than 8 x 8 inches. Holds are reversible and will be released if the model is not present by 6:45 PM Saturday. To join the list, send the project name and tray footprint before 7:30 PM tonight.

parameter.content: Heads up, the macro-photo list is already full and staff said the volunteer is printing the slot cards now. They are not adding overflow because the backdrop has to be packed right after the last scheduled shot.
